name: Francisco Varela

early_history_summary: Varela received a strong classical education at the German Lyceum in Santiago and earned his M.Sc. in Biology from the University of Chile at age 20 under Humberto Maturana. He then moved to Harvard for his Ph.D., completing it at age 23 under Torsten Wiesel with a thesis on information processing in insect compound eyes.

primary_early_advantage_tags: elite education, Harvard, mentorship, prosperous family, early academic talent
evidence_summary: Varela was born into a prosperous intellectual family in Chile and received a strong classical education at the German Lyceum in Santiago. He earned his M.Sc. in Biology from the University of Chile at age 20, studying under neurobiologist Humberto Maturana. He then pursued a Ph.D. at Harvard University under Torsten Wiesel (later a Nobel laureate), completing it at age 23 in 1970. His access to elite academic institutions and world-class mentors from an early age provided him with a rare intellectual platform. By his mid-twenties, he had already begun formulating the theory of autopoiesis with Maturana.
starting_point: Born to a prosperous intellectual family in Talcahuano, Chile; father Raúl Varela and mother Corina García raised their sons in Santiago with access to excellent education.

primary_early_advantage_tags: early composing, elite music education, mentorship, Darmstadt, prodigy
evidence_summary: Rihm was born in Karlsruhe to a middle-class family; his father was a Red Cross treasurer and his mother a homemaker. He began composing at age 11 and won a prize at the Jugend musiziert competition at 16, demonstrating early prodigious talent. He studied composition at the Hochschule für Musik Karlsruhe while still in secondary school, then attended the elite Darmstadt Summer Courses from 1970 and studied with Karlheinz Stockhausen. The premiere of his Morphonie at the 1974 Donaueschingen Festival at age 22 won him international recognition. His sustained mentorship under major composers and immersion in the European new music ecosystem were key early advantages.
